traitor.title: Traitor's Tome
traitor.text:
### Setup
- Your explorer stays in the game but is now the traitor.
- Discard the Ring.
- Take a pentagonal item token, representing a Smartphone.
- Remove the Sanity clip from your character card. You no longer have a Sanity value: you can't be attacked with Sanity, lose Sanity, or make Sanity rolls (for example, to resist the Music Box) without that score.
- Put a plastic clip at 1 on the Turn/Damage track. It keeps track of time.

### Rules
#### You must do this on your turn
- At the start of your turn, move the Turn/Damage track clip to the next number.
- Do this only when your traitor character's turn comes up, even if your character has been killed. Do not do it on the turns of former heroes who have been driven mad and joined you.

#### Special attack rules
- You gain a new action you may take at any time during your traitor turn: **Share social media killings**. You may take it even if your character is dead.
- Once during your turn, for each Smartphone (dropped ones included), do the following in order:
  - Choose a hero in that Smartphone's room.
  - If reception has not been established for that room, the hero looks for reception (the hero knows how). If the room contains a Dead Zone (an Obstacle token) or is in the basement, stop the process for that room here.
  - Tell the hero that the Smartphone shows gruesome photos of their Flitter friends, all of whom have been killed somewhere in the outside world.
  - Make a Sanity attack against that hero with a number of dice equal to the number on the Turn/Damage track plus the number of Bars of reception (small monster tokens) in the room, to a maximum of 8 dice. The hero defends with Sanity and takes Sanity damage if they lose.
> Note: The book says "Choose a hero in the room" for each Smartphone; this is read as the Smartphone's room. How a hero looks for reception and how Bars are gained are in Secrets of Survival.

#### How to add friends to your network
- When a hero's Sanity drops to the skull symbol, that hero becomes your friend and is no longer a hero. Read your new friend these instructions:
  - You are not dead; you are now the traitor's insane friend.
  - Remove the Sanity clip from your character card. You no longer have a Sanity value.
  - You keep taking turns in normal order, but your goal is now to stop the heroes from escaping, which may include killing them.

#### Special dropped Smartphone rules
- If a hero ends their turn in a room with no Smartphone, you may attempt a Knowledge roll of 5+ to move a dropped Smartphone (if one exists) into that hero's room.
> Note: The book does not say whose Knowledge is used if your character is dead.

### Traitor wins when
- Every hero has either been driven mad and joined your side, or been killed.

### What they know about the other side
- The heroes are locked in the house and are trying to use their Smartphones to call outside help to break them out before you "unfriend" all of them.

heroes.title: Secrets of Survival
heroes.text:
### Setup
- Each hero takes a pentagonal item token, representing a Smartphone.
- Set aside all the small monster tokens (representing Bars of reception) and Obstacle tokens (representing Dead Zones).

### Rules
#### How to Use Your Smartphone
- Once during your turn, if you have a Smartphone, you may either look for reception or call for help. You can also lose your phone.
- **Look for reception** (any non-basement room):
  - Roll 1 die on the ground floor, or 2 dice on the upper floor or roof.
  - Add 1 to the result if the room has a window or is outside (see this expansion's rule sheet).
  - The total is the number of Bars of reception in that room. Put that many Bar tokens (maximum five) in the room. If the result is zero Bars, put a Dead Zone token in the room instead.
  - You may not look for reception again in a room whose reception has already been established.
- **Call for help** (in a room with at least one Bar): roll 4 dice and add the room's number of Bars. On a total of 9+, help is on the way (see How to Escape the House).
- **Lose your phone:** you can lose it the way you would an item card, but doing so is frowned on: if you willingly drop a Smartphone, or give it to another hero, lower your Sanity by 1 die.
- Once a hero's Sanity drops to the skull symbol, that hero becomes a "friend" of the traitor. That explorer reads this haunt in the Traitor's Tome.

#### How to Escape the House
- When help is on the way, add the number of living heroes to the number currently marked on the Turn/Damage track, and mark the resulting turn with a spare clip so everyone knows when help arrives. Example: four living heroes make a successful call on turn 3, so help arrives on turn 7.
- On the turn help arrives, or any later turn, any hero in the Entrance Hall lets the police into the house, and the heroes win.

### Heroes win when
- At least one hero with a positive Sanity escapes the house. The front door is locked and the windows boarded up, so they must call for help (see above).
> Note: The win condition requires a hero "with a positive Sanity", while How to Escape the House says any hero in the Entrance Hall lets the police in once help has arrived; a hero at the skull symbol has already become a "friend" of the traitor, so the two are presumably consistent.

### What they know about the other side
- The traitor has been driven insane by some unknown force, and that same force is about to drive the heroes mad too, if the traitor doesn't kill them first.
